build_hashing_memory: build a hashing memory module with configurable keys, query networks, and product quantization
create_memory_flat: create a flat hashing memory implementation using dot-product similarity for index retrieval
create_memory_product: create a product quantization memory implementation splitting keys into halves for compressed retrieval

test_memory_params: test memory parameter validation and initialization with argparse-compatible configuration flags
